Private URIs using the g prefix are pointers to the respective lemmas in the FFDB collection of glossaries. Glossaries were taken from the original text source.

body.p: There lived once a mouse. A reindeer lived there as well. One day the reindeer said to the mouse: "Oh, you are so small. You only go in one place. You cannot see anything." The mouse said: "Let's see. Let us play. I'll look for you first, and then you'll look for me." "OK!" The reindeer said. The reindeer went far away and the mouse has started looking for it. It (the mouse) sees that the reindeer's antler is visible from the grass. The mouse quickly found the reindeer. Now the reindeer is looking for the mouse. The mouse has hid in the moss. The reindeer looks for it (the mouse), but cannot find it. The reindeer looks for the mouse all day long. He's totally out of strength. "Mouse, come out! I cannot find you anywhere." Since then, the reindeer has never joked with the mouse.
